name: Mars 2
first: A Soviet orbiter and lander launched to Mars in 1971: the lander crashed, the orbiter worked
description: Mars 2 was a Soviet spacecraft made of an orbiter and a lander. It launched on 1971-05-19 on a Proton-K with a Blok D upper stage, nine days before its twin Mars 3. The descent module separated about 4.5 hours before arrival. Its descent system malfunctioned, the parachute did not deploy and the lander crashed on Mars. The orbiter entered Mars orbit on 1971-11-27 into an 18-hour orbit and sent data until about August 1972.

events.label: LAUNCH
events.note: Proton-K with Blok-D upper stage from Baikonur, 1971-05-19.

events.label: LANDER LOST
events.note: The descent module separated about 4.5 hours before arrival; the lander crashed.
